column2: [intro]
In the street, I sit at a terrace
I see lovers, friends in a rush
Their eyes meet, like a romance
I imagine their lives, in my trance
Dancing with glances, it's my pastime
Observing people, it's so sublime
I lose myself in their stories, full of strife
Dancing with glances, it's my delight
At the café, I see a woman with a marked face
She hides her tears, feeling out of place
Her sad eyes make me feel a bit swayed
I wonder if I can help, in any way
Dancing with glances, it's my pastime
Observing people, it's so sublime
I lose myself in their stories, full of strife
Dancing with glances, it's my delight
[ solo ]
In the crowd, I feel free as air
Dancing with glances, a mystery there
I'm the silent witness of life so rare
Dancing with glances, my world to share
[outro]
